blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Police seized an improvised explosive device (IED), eight M203 grenades and seven Molotov cocktails during a security operation in the town of Uson in Masbate, on Wednesday. Also seized were two handheld radios, six short steel magazines, a white plastic bucket with a cover and a buffer tube. Police took custody of the recovered items for documentation and inventory.
